about_the_game:
🎮 Golf King

Swing your club, conquer the world!
Golf King combines realistic golf physics with limitless creative gameplay. Whether you’re a competitive pro or a casual player looking for fun, you’ll find your own golf joy here.

⛳ Three Modes, Endless Fun

🏌️‍♂️ Course Mode

  • Random Courses — Over 100+ course combinations, every round feels brand new.

  • Ink-Painting World — Experience golf in the unique Chinese landscape “A Thousand Miles of Rivers and Mountains.”

🎉 Entertainment Mode

  • Landing Challenge — Classic TopGolf-style precision play.

  • Cyber City Battle — Tee off from neon rooftops in a futuristic metropolis.

  • Cliffside Green Attack — Hit targets in mystical floating cliffs.

  • Bowling Showdown — Golf meets bowling—strike with your putter!

  • Blackjack 21 — A creative mix of golf and cards, outwit AI rivals.

  • Victory Island — An endless putting challenge on an ever-expanding island.

🏌️‍♀️ Practice Mode

  • Classic Driving Range — Pure and realistic training.

  • Sakura Range — Strike gongs amid cherry blossoms.

  • Sakura Pro — Hit glowing rings to awaken a mighty dragon.

  • Tomorrowland Range — Face hordes of zombies with golf balls.

  • Fishing Master — Battle sharks on the open sea with golf shots!

🌟 Features

  • Realistic physics: Every swing tests your skill and strategy.

  • Creative crossover gameplay: Mixing golf with art, sci-fi, and more.

  • For everyone: Compete, relax, or train—your choice.

🏆 In Golf King, rise and become the true master of the course!
